text:
acme-ops: Hey team, starting ~10:38 PST we saw a spike of 5xx/504s from the rerank endpoint when running bulk jobs. p95 for rerank jumped from ~120ms to 3.2s, then downstream gateway started returning 504s. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Using hosted us-west-2. Candidates per request ~50, queries batched 8. Can someone triage?

anya (support): sorry about that — thanks for flagging. Can you paste the curl you used + the x-request-id header? Are retries enabled on your client? Also: are these long sequences for candidates? :eyes:

acme-ops: x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d. curl we ran attached below (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ***" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"query":"How to set up SSO","candidates": ["... 50 items ..."], "return_scores": true}'
```
Retries: yes, simple immediate retry loop in our job runner (no backoff). Sequence lengths for candidates vary, some ~800 tokens.

sanjay (eng-runtime): seeing a correlated spike in our metrics at 10:38 — backend model servers show long-tail latency for batches that include sequences >512, and we observed KV cache evictions causing extra compute. Gateway (nginx) started returning 504 after queue timeout when head-of-line batches hit a slow request. Also noticed many client immediate retries causing request amplification.

leo (sre): deploy-bot shows a non-functional rollout at 09:55 that increased max batch size on the gateway layer (rolled back at 10:05). Relevant: gateway_timeout was 30s. At the time of the spike, queue depth + retries pushed processing beyond that.

anya (support): for a quick workaround can you try reducing candidate count to 16 and add exponential backoff between retries? Customer reported improvement testing locally.

acme-ops: tried reducing to 16 and adding jittered backoff (100ms -> 800ms) — p95 dropped to ~160ms and no 504s during the test. Good short-term result. :thumbsup:

sanjay (eng-runtime): follow-up notes for us: 1) add server-side early-reject when candidate_count > 32 with a 400+explain to avoid thundering herd, 2) improve batch shaping to avoid mixing long sequences with short ones, 3) add a per-tenant in-flight cap for hosted customers to smooth bursts. I'll open an internal task.

leo (sre): medium-term: consider raising gateway timeout to 45s and implement retry budget / token bucket for callers to limit amplification. But agree: change the surface area first (server-side caps).

deploy-bot: Rollout info: "gateway-config v2.14" attempted at 09:55 UTC, rollback at 10:05 UTC. No other deployments between 10:00-11:00.

kai (support): documenting repro steps for the ticket: 1) POST rerank with 40-60 candidates, some candidates ~600-900 tokens, 2) run 8 parallel batches, 3) no client backoff -> reproduce 504/gateway spikes. Workaround: cap candidates <= 20 and add exponential backoff with jitter.

anya (support): marking this as triaged/escalated. Customer workaround confirmed. Eng-runtime to track the internal tasks and SRE to propose gateway mitigations. I'll update the support ticket with the repro and workaround.

acme-ops: thanks everyone — workaround is fine for now, please keep us posted on the follow-ups.

sanjay (eng-runtime): created task INF-3421: "rerank: server-side candidate cap + batch shaping" and linked SRE for gateway retry budget design.

kai (support): closing loop in support ticket, will re-open if regressions. Thanks all.
